lines: Riders see problems and ideas first. Now Feedback sits in the custom ride's header, and the ride pauses while you write.
Pick Bug, Improvement or Kudos. The question, its example and the button change with it, and a bug attaches diagnostics.
Every note carries the ride as it stood: the workout, the segment, resistance, power, the bike and the last command, listed so you can see what goes.
Sending locks the form and says so. Once accepted, the thanks fits the kind, and Done leaves the ride paused. If it fails, your note is kept.
Seven acceptance tests failed first and pass now. A bug report carries the last megabyte of the packet log and the app version, never a token.
A bottom sheet on a phone, a popover under the button from tablet up.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
